trap.label: for e since
trap.right: She has been a nurse since 2015.
trap.why: O português usa o presente para estados que continuam; em inglês estados que duram até agora pedem have been.

fix.right: I have been here since noon.

fix.wrong: We've known him since ten years.
fix.right: We've known him for ten years.

fix.wrong: She have worked here for a year.
fix.right: She has worked here for a year.
